description: F-CORE-029: the read side of `closePeriod`, `reopenPeriod` and `closeFiscalYear`. Three operations decided what may still be posted and no projection said what they had decided — `systemDescription` names the invariant ('a closed period accepts no further postings') without naming the periods. What was left was `auditLog`, and a trail is not a state: replaying it into 'period 3 is open' makes the application rebuild library state from a log, and it is wrong the moment something closes a period without passing through that application. `start` and `end` come out with it because without them there is no period LIST: this fixture uses a fiscal year running July to June, where twelve calendar months would be an invention, and where period 1 is July.

expect.comment: Reopened again, so the projection has to report a state rather than a high-water mark: period 1 closed, period 2 open behind it.

Period 1 is July 2025 — the point of reporting start and end rather than a number an application would have to interpret. The year itself is open; a year is closed by closeFiscalYear, not by the periods under it.
